# Kořeny osobností

A joint project by Darina Miklovičová and Prague Botanical Garden. A Czech and English catalogue of personalities, representatives and plants. Unknown dates are marked explicitly. Sources are listed at the bottom of each detail page.

The honoured personality and the actual planter or family representative may be different people. A plant detail describes the botanical species or cultivar, not necessarily a photograph of the living specimen in the garden. The planting year is not the publication date. `verified_on` records fact-checking, not the date when a page was modified.

`catalog.json` preserves the source records and adds canonical Czech and English `language_urls`, translated `descriptions`, and links between entries, people and plants. Main participants share their planting detail; follow these canonical URLs instead of constructing legacy `/lide/` or `/en/participants/` detail addresses.

- [Czech catalogue](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/osobnosti/)
- [English catalogue](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/en/people/)
- [Czech plants](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/rostliny/)
- [Plants](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/en/plants/)
- [Czech participants](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/lide/)
- [Participants](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/en/participants/)
- [Structured catalogue](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/catalog.json)
- [Czech planting years](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/roky/)
- [English planting years](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/en/years/)
- [Czech project and methodology](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/o-projektu/)
- [About and methodology](https://www.koreny-osobnosti.cz/en/about/)
